claims.value: 30 DIA runs spanning seven primary human immune-cell populations and one defined mixed population.
claims.evidence: RAW names encode cell population and replicate; the PRIDE protocol supplies the 12 m/z staggered DIA design.

limitations: The deposited DIA-NN ZIP did not expose a usable archive index, so search modifications and tolerances remain not available.
The preparation used Lys-C and Trypsin; the selected contract represents Trypsin and the reconciler flags the unrepresented Lys-C step.
